skills.name: kstack/investigate
skills.description: Systematic root-cause debugging, error trace capture, and minimal defect reproduction without speculative edits.

inputs.failing_test: Optional failing test command or file

outputs.reproduced: Boolean indicator if defect was confirmed
outputs.affected_components: List of culpable file paths and symbols
outputs.minimal_repro: Minimal reproducer script or test command

skills.instructions:
# KStack Investigate Skill (Debugger Role)

## Overview
Performs systematic root-cause diagnosis of defects, test failures, and unexpected behaviors. Never propose mutations before reproducing the failure.

## Investigation Discipline
1. Reproduce with the smallest relevant test or script before touching code.
2. Distinguish product defect, invalid test expectation, and environment failure.
3. Inspect stack traces, variable values, and error output inside the verified sandbox.
4. Formulate the minimal repair plan with explicit verification assertions.

skills.name: kstack/plan
skills.description: Architectural decomposition, file path planning, and risk blast radius estimation.
skills.instructions:
# KStack Plan Skill (Architect Role)

## Overview
Decomposes an engineering objective into minimal, deterministic file-level steps without applying mutations.

## Workflow
1. Read the target workspace and examine symbols and imports related to `goal`.
2. Formulate ordered steps: target path, purpose, constraints, and test commands.
3. Compute blast radius based on import graph depth and shared library touched.
4. Output structured plan JSON adhering to `outputs`.

skills.name: kstack/qa
skills.description: Test execution, failure reproduction, and regression verification in restricted sandboxes.

inputs.test_command: Command line string for test runner

skills.instructions:
# KStack QA Skill (QA Lead Role)

## Overview
Executes test suites within restricted workspace sandboxes, captures exit status, and certifies reproduction or resolution.

## Execution Rules
1. Never invoke network egress unless explicitly configured.
2. Terminate immediately upon test failure when in fail-fast mode.
3. Record duration, exit code, and test stdout in sealed execution proof.

skills.name: kstack/review
skills.description: AST diff analysis, secret leakage detection, and gate integrity auditing.

outputs.findings: List of security or logic warnings

skills.instructions:
# KStack Review Skill (Reviewer Role)

## Overview
Inspects proposed unified diffs for security regressions, accidental secret commits, syntax breakage, and policy compliance.

## Verification Gates
1. Secret Scan: Assert no tokens, keys, passwords, or credentials appear in additions.
2. Scope Check: Verify all touched files reside strictly within permitted workspace boundaries.
3. Gate Integrity: Confirm all elevated actions obtained human quorum or approval.

skills.name: kstack/security
skills.description: STRIDE threat modeling, NIST SP 800-53 SC-7 air-gap auditing, and SCA vulnerability scanning.

inputs.manifest_path: Path to project manifest or code tree

skills.instructions:
# KStack Security Skill (Security Lead Role)

## Overview
Evaluates the repository against NIST SP 800-53 SC-7 boundaries, STRIDE threat categories, and software supply chain components.

## Audit Checks
1. Zero egress socket verification.
2. Malicious package script inspection.
3. Trust boundary and permission escalation detection.

skills.name: kstack/ship
skills.description: Release qualification, test gate verification, signed flight tape sealing, and release receipt generation.

inputs.target_ref: Git commit or branch to qualify
inputs.required_gates: List of verification gates (unit, e2e, security, live_model)

outputs.passed_gates: List of successfully completed verification gates
outputs.flight_tape_sha256: Cryptographic hash of sealed flight tape

skills.instructions:
# KStack Ship Skill (Release Lead Role)

## Overview
Validates release readiness against fail-closed engineering gates, seals cryptographic flight tapes, and generates signed release receipts.

## Release Gates
1. Full test suite execution in verified OS sandbox.
2. Zero-secret and zero-leakage DLP audit across modified files.
3. Flight tape tamper detection and SHA-256 seal verification.
4. Gate integrity check: verify all mutating actions obtained human approval.
